result.title: Bernoulli On-Policy Distillation: Don't Ignore High-Confidence Student Tokens
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own trajectories using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. We show that standard sampled reverse-KL OPD systematically suppresses updates to high-confidence tokens, such that their weak gradient contribution does not necessarily imply weak or uninformative teacher supervision. We introduce Bernoulli On-Policy Distillation (Bernoulli OPD), which directly matches the teacher and student probabilities for that token. This yields a bounded probability space correction that preserves teacher-student disagreement while avoiding the additional confidence-dependent suppression induced by vanilla OPD. Fixed-rollout analyses show that Bernoulli OPD substantially restores optimization signal to high-confidence tokens while remaining sensitive to teacher-student disagreement. We further analyze the resulting model behavior through confidence distributions, answer calibration, policy movement, and training dynamics, showing that Bernoulli OPD's gains cannot be explained simply by longer reasoning, larger optimization steps, or more uniform imitation of the teacher. Code is available at https://github.com/duterscmy/Bernoulli-OPD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析标准采样 reverse-KL on-policy distillation 会系统性压低对高置信度 student token 的更新，并提出 Bernoulli OPD，通过直接匹配该 token 的师生概率来避免额外的置信度相关抑制，恢复优化信号。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本蒸馏方法，不涉及视觉或 latent 生成，但其关于 token 级监督梯度随置信度衰减的分析，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹蒸馏中答案与中间推理步骤的监督贡献分配与损失加权。
